versions.changelog:
order-analytics v0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Converts raw order data (Excel/CSV) into an interactive HTML business analytics dashboard, suitable for venues, retail, F&B, and service industries.
- Covers comprehensive business analysis across 6 tabs: Trends, Comparison, Time Slots, User Structure, Dianping Traffic (if applicable), and Operational Strategy.
- Implements strict monthly average metrics (no partial-month or non-equivalent comparisons).
- Supports custom color themes via logo extraction, HEX/RGB input, or preset themes.
- Mobile-responsive by default, with all grids and charts adapting for small screens.
- Provides reference example, code snippets, and verification checks for report completeness.
